description: This file defines the InputState class and related methods for managing input events, including key and motion event tracking, cancellation, and merging in the Android input dispatcher system.

classes.name: InputState
classes.description: Manages the state of input events, including tracking keys and motions, synthesizing cancelation events, and merging pointer states.

classes.name: InputState::MotionMemento
classes.description: Represents a snapshot of motion event state, including pointers and hover status.

methods.name: isHovering
methods.description: Checks if a device with given ID, source, and display ID is currently hovering.

methods.name: trackKey
methods.description: Tracks key events, updating internal mementos based on key actions.

methods.name: trackMotion
methods.description: Tracks motion events, updating internal mementos based on motion actions.

methods.name: findKeyMemento
methods.description: Finds the index of a key memento matching a given key entry.

methods.name: findMotionMemento
methods.description: Finds the index of a motion memento matching a given motion entry and hover state.

methods.name: addKeyMemento
methods.description: Adds a new key memento to the internal list.

methods.name: addMotionMemento
methods.description: Adds a new motion memento to the internal list.

methods.name: setPointers
methods.description: Sets pointer properties and coordinates in a motion memento based on a motion entry.

methods.name: mergePointerStateTo
methods.description: Merges pointer state from one memento into another.

methods.name: synthesizeCancelationEvents
methods.description: Generates cancelation events for tracked keys and motions based on options.

methods.name: synthesizePointerDownEvents
methods.description: Synthesizes pointer down events for motion mementos.

methods.name: synthesizeCancelationEventsForPointers
methods.description: Creates cancelation events for specific pointers within a motion memento.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all tracked key and motion mementos and fallback keys.

methods.name: mergePointerStateTo
methods.description: Merges pointer states from this InputState into another.

methods.name: getFallbackKey
methods.description: Retrieves fallback key code for a given original key code, if any.

methods.name: setFallbackKey
methods.description: Sets a fallback key code for a given original key code.

methods.name: removeFallbackKey
methods.description: Removes fallback key mapping for a given original key code.

methods.name: shouldCancelKey
methods.description: Determines if a key memento should be canceled based on options.

methods.name: shouldCancelMotion
methods.description: Determines if a motion memento should be canceled based on options.
